reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet to carry around solves a problem I don't have. I also have a drawer of half-used bottles and a cheap bottle does the same job for me.
objection: I'd be paying about a dollar a day for the packaging, when I'm home every evening anyway and a regular bottle costs a fraction of that.
would_change_my_mind: A real flash sale or coupon that brings it close to what my bottle costs per day, or me actually traveling a lot.
